rejection_reasons: identity/brand_placement: The reference packaging has a large vertical Colgate logo; the generated visible product lacks the brand on the toothbrush and the tube/card branding is not placed like the official pack.

identity/typography_placement: Official text such as SOFT, MAX WHITE ULTRA, and Colgate appears on the tall retail pack in specific positions; the generated creative relocates text to a separate card and toothpaste tube.

identity/packaging: The official product is shown in a tall red retail blister/card pack with window and printed brush image, while the generated image shows a toothpaste tube and small display card instead.
